name: New York Championship 2022
information: # All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof that they satisfy one of the following two requirements in order to be allowed in the venue: ##### -They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Saturday, June 18th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. **OR** ##### -They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Tuesday, June 28th is insufficient for entrance to the competition.
